title: Monster
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>

  <ellipse cx="50" cy="62" rx="30" ry="28" fill="#6B3FA0"/>

  <ellipse cx="50" cy="58" rx="24" ry="20" fill="#8B5FC0"/>

  <ellipse cx="50" cy="72" rx="16" ry="12" fill="#B8E040"/>

  <ellipse cx="36" cy="88" rx="10" ry="6" fill="#5A2E90"/>
  <!-- Right leg -->
  <ellipse cx="64" cy="88" rx="10" ry="6" fill="#5A2E90"/>

  <ellipse cx="34" cy="89" rx="5" ry="3" fill="#B8E040"/>
  <!-- Right foot light -->
  <ellipse cx="66" cy="89" rx="5" ry="3" fill="#B8E040"/>

  <ellipse cx="20" cy="60" rx="8" ry="14" fill="#6B3FA0" transform="rotate(20 20 60)"/>

  <ellipse cx="80" cy="60" rx="8" ry="14" fill="#6B3FA0" transform="rotate(-20 80 60)"/>

  <circle cx="14" cy="72" r="6" fill="#8B5FC0"/>

  <circle cx="60" cy="48" r="5" fill="#FF4060"/>
  <circle cx="62" cy="46" r="2" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <!-- Mouth -->
  <path d="M36 60 Q50 74 64 60" stroke="#FF6080" stroke-width="3" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- Teeth -->
  <polygon points="42,61 45,68 48,61" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <polygon points="52,61 55,68 58,61" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <!-- Left horn -->
  <polygon points="30,38 24,18 38,34" fill="#FFB040"/>
  <!-- Right horn -->
  <polygon points="70,38 76,18 62,34" fill="#FFB040"/>
  <!-- Spikes on head -->
  <polygon points="44,32 50,22 56,32" fill="#FF7090"/>
  <!-- Left cheek glow -->
  <circle cx="28" cy="56" r="4" fill="#FF80A0" opacity="0.6"/>
  <!-- Right cheek glow -->
  <circle cx="72" cy="56" r="4" fill="#FF80A0" opacity="0.6"/>
